description: This is a rectangular rug with a rich, intricate design. The central medallion is a complex floral pattern in shades of red and yellow, set against a dark background. Surrounding the medallion are multiple borders, also featuring floral motifs and geometric patterns in red, yellow, and black. The main field of the rug is a repeated diamond or octagonal pattern filled with smaller floral elements and geometric bands. The outer edge of the rug has a deep burgundy border, and the fringed ends are visible along one side in white. The overall impression is one of traditional craftsmanship and ornate beauty.
